import json

data = json.loads(files)
entries = data.get("entries", [])

# Build a tree structure from paths
tree = {}
for e in entries:
    # Make path relative to /workspace/
    p = e["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = p.split("/")
    current = tree
    for part in parts[:-1]:
        current = current.setdefault(part, {})
    # Leaf: store size
    current[parts[-1]] = e["size_bytes"]

def print_tree(node, prefix="", is_last=True):
    lines = []
    items = sorted(node.items(), key=lambda x: (not isinstance(x[1], dict), x[0]))
    for i, (name, val) in enumerate(items):
        last = (i == len(items) - 1)
        connector = "└── " if last else "├── "
        if isinstance(val, dict):
            lines.append(f"{prefix}{connector}📁 {name}/")
            extension = "    " if last else "│   "
            lines.extend(print_tree(val, prefix + extension, last))
        else:
            size_kb = val / 1024
            lines.append(f"{prefix}{connector}📄 {name} ({size_kb:.1f} KB)")
    return lines

tree_lines = print_tree(tree)
output = f"📂 Workspace Root ({len(entries)} files total)\n" + "\n".join(tree_lines)
print(output)
